Polymarket is a prediction market platform that lets users trade shares on the outcomes of real-world events. Polymarket runs on the Polygon blockchain. Polymarket settles trades in USDC. Polymarket uses a hybrid model in which orders are matched off-chain and settled on-chain.

Ondo Finance tokenizes real-world assets, such as United States Treasury exposure, on blockchains. Ondo Finance issues tokens that are offered on multiple public blockchains, including Ethereum. Ondo Finance targets institutional and qualified investors, so some of its products are access-restricted.

Lightning Network is a layer-2 payment network built on top of the Bitcoin blockchain. Lightning Network uses payment channels so that most transactions are processed off-chain. Lightning Network aims to provide fast payments with low fees.

TRON is a layer-1 public blockchain that uses a delegated proof-of-stake consensus mechanism. TRON has a native token called TRX. TRON supports smart contracts that run on the TRON Virtual Machine, which is compatible with the Ethereum Virtual Machine. TRON is widely used for stablecoin transfers, particularly USDT.

Stellar (XLM) is an open-source, decentralized blockchain network designed for payments and asset transfers. Stellar (XLM) uses the Stellar Consensus Protocol, a federated Byzantine agreement mechanism. Stellar (XLM) has a native asset called lumens (XLM). Stellar (XLM) supports smart contracts through its Soroban platform.
